title: Settings a person has to decide, not a script

corrections.decision: Bug reports and corrections go through the GitHub issue tracker. Chosen deliberately: an issue is public, threaded, timestamped and linked to the commit that fixes it, which an inbox is not. The trade-off is that it needs a free GitHub account, so the counsellor route below is the answer for a student who does not have one and does not want one.
corrections.counsellorRoute: Tell your study counsellor or a teacher. They can raise it for you, and they will usually know whether it is a mistake here or a change at the university.

responseTargets.unsafeClaim: Removed or marked as unverified within one working day of being reported, while it is checked.
responseTargets.deadlineOrRequirement: Checked within three working days. These are the claims that cost a student a year.
responseTargets.anythingElse: Checked at the next review pass.

independence.institutionalRelationships: The site is maintained at Ikast-Brande Gymnasium. No institution listed on it has been consulted about, paid for, or given sight of its own entry before publication.

ordering.explanation: Destinations, institutions and programmes are listed alphabetically unless a student chooses otherwise. Nothing on this site is ranked, and no institution can change where it appears.

localStorageKeys.holds: IB subjects, levels, grades, predicted total and fee status
which destinations you chose to compare

privacy.plainLanguage: Nothing you type here is sent anywhere. Your subjects and grades are stored in your own browser, on this device only. There are no accounts, no cookies and no analytics of any kind — not anonymised analytics, none. Clearing your browser data, or using the clear button on the subject checker, erases it.

homeDoors.decision: Which photographs open the home page: the hero (in order) and each door, as image keys in data/images.json. An editorial choice, made by looking at the pictures, and chosen so that no photograph on the home page appears twice.

feedback.decision: While the site is shown to students and counsellors for feedback, a slim bar on every page links to a feedback form. Paste the form link (Microsoft Forms, Google Forms or similar) into url; set url to null to remove the bar.
feedback.message: This is a preview for students and counsellors.
